note: Dated events during 23 Oct – 1 Nov 2026, pulled from multiple sources (SmartShanghai, Time Out, venue sites, ticketing/gig listings). Entries are never deleted by a refresh: a listing that has ended gets "archived": true (plus "archivedOn") and moves into the page's 'Earlier finds' disclosure, so nothing is lost. `added` drives the New flag for its first 14 days and is never rewritten. `start`/`end` (ISO, either omissible for open-ended runs) place an entry: long runs render under 'Running throughout', short ones slot into the day-by-day calendar on their first in-window day. Git history holds every past version of this file.

events.title: On Top of the World Tree
events.blurb: Nearly 3,000 artefacts from Mexico, Peru and China, tracing the Olmec, Maya and Inca alongside their Shang and Zhou counterparts. Walking distance from the hotel, closed Mondays; timed tickets via WeChat.

events.title: Reinventing Landscape
events.blurb: Volume IV of the museum's five-year Pompidou collaboration, around 70 works from the French collection. Three minutes' walk from the Long Museum and Tank Shanghai, both already on the Sunday. Closed Mondays.

events.title: Sleep No More
events.blurb: Punchdrunk's masked-audience immersive theatre, in its permanent Shanghai run. Daily except Monday and Tuesday, three-plus hours, entirely solo-friendly by design. Book ahead via SmartTicket or the venue.

events.title: Fotografiska Wednesday Jazz
events.blurb: Foto Live jazz-and-cocktails on the 4F lounge stage. The 28th is your Wednesday — sits between the M50 walk and dinner if you'd rather keep the evening on than order in.

events.title: Jota Mombaça: stuck in movement (in the tide)
events.blurb: Three shows open together on the 22nd: Mombaça's fragmented, planetary-grief opera anchors the museum alongside Kandis Williams' collage piece A Cave and Wong Kit Yi's karaoke-themed companion work. On the Bund, a short hop from People's Square.

events.title: China Shanghai International Arts Festival
events.blurb: The 25th edition spreads opera, dance, theatre and music across the city's big stages through October and November. The programme firms up closer in — worth a skim for anything landing in your ten days.

events.title: Stratovarius
events.blurb: Finnish power-metal veterans, in town on Halloween night of all nights. Not remotely jazz — but it's the one dated gig on your Saturday so far, and MAO on a costume night would be a scene.
